last_completed_unit.target: Cargo stable cargo vendor implementation at rust-lang/cargo commit 7941be6fb416b4cd9666aef7b858dfea25587a8c
last_completed_unit.action: Inspected exactly the official Cargo cargo_vendor.rs implementation needed to determine checksum-map construction and stale vendor-directory cleanup behavior.
last_completed_unit.result: For package destinations that Cargo repopulates, cargo vendor removes the destination, repopulates selected files, records a checksum for every copied/included path, and writes that map as .cargo-checksum.json files. Default vendoring also deletes unmatched non-dot top-level vendor entries. A version-suffixed registry package with an existing .cargo-checksum.json is instead reused via an early continue before removal or checksum recomputation, so stale extra internal files are not proven to be cleaned on that path. --no-delete preserves unmatched top-level entries.
